SELECT cls,
  CASE WHEN fish_date_doy<316 THEN '306-315' WHEN fish_date_doy<326 THEN '316-325' ELSE '326-335' END AS bucket,
  COUNT(*) n, SUM(yt) yt, SUM(anglers) anglers, ROUND(SUM(yt)/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),3) ypa
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=2 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 306 AND 335
  AND cls IN ('day_1_5','overnight','three_quarter')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1
SELECT value, avail_doy FROM climate WHERE index_id='oni' AND avail_season=2 ORDER BY avail_doy DESC LIMIT 3
